notes: so that is one rendering of the waw under rule 55, headed on the coordinator so; the competing head that is named in the unit's note.
בְּגַן הָאֱלֹהִים has a single written the, which goes to the present article on the rectum and leaves the construct bare (rule 29); contrast the two-the phrases elsewhere in this chapter.
were in (t019–t020) is rule 49's prepositional predicate in the verbless relative clause, headed on the preposition.
